The Official YouTube Channel for Oulton College.

Since 1956, the Oulton College name has been synonymous with job-ready, highly-trained graduates. Located in Moncton, New Brunswick, Oulton College offers programs in four faculties: Business, Health Science, Human Services, and Information Technology. With state-of-the-art facilities and a faculty of over 50 members, Oulton College offers students a quality education that prepares them for the work-force.
